subject_line: KetoDial Is Live, a 500-Day Stall Breakthrough, and the Real Cost of Ozempic
opening: Okay so this was a big week. We officially launched KetoDial, our free keto macro calculator, and honestly the response has been incredible. We also dropped posts on bridal carnivore protocols, why eggs and dairy are your best anchors, a starter gift guide, and how to eat carnivore without going broke. On the video side, we covered the lion diet, the real biological costs of Ozempic, and a wild 500-day stall breakthrough that you need to hear about. Let's get into it.

blog_teasers.title: We Built Something for the Keto Questions
blog_teasers.teaser: We kept hearing the same questions about keto macros, so we built KetoDial — a free calculator that gives you personalized targets in 30 seconds. Here's why we made it.

blog_teasers.title: The 90-Day Bridal Carnivore Protocol
blog_teasers.teaser: A practical timeline for brides who want to feel their best on the big day — no crash diets, no gimmicks, just a structured carnivore approach that actually works.

blog_teasers.title: Eggs and Dairy: The Long-Term Carnivore Anchor
blog_teasers.teaser: Most people start with steak. The ones who stick around learn to love eggs, butter, and cheese. Here's why these staples matter more than you think.

blog_teasers.title: Your First Month Carnivore Without Going Broke
blog_teasers.teaser: The biggest objection to carnivore is cost. Marcus breaks down exactly how to eat well for under $200 a month — with a full shopping list.

whats_trending:
KetoDial is live (and free): We built a keto macro calculator from scratch because most of the ones out there are either paywalled or trying to sell you something. KetoDial gives you personalized macros in about 30 seconds, no account required. Early feedback from the community has been really positive.

The real cost of GLP-1 shortcuts: Kent Carnivore's video on the biological costs of Ozempic and Mounjaro hit 109K views and the comments section is on fire. People are split between "let them have the drugs" and "you're trading one problem for another." It's the biggest debate in the community right now and it's not slowing down.

Lion diet vs standard carnivore: Emma's 30-day lion diet experiment is making the rounds and the results are hard to ignore. Turns out stripping it down to just beef, salt, and water actually helped her identify triggers she'd been missing for months. If you've been stalled or dealing with mystery inflammation, the elimination approach is worth a serious look.
community_pulse: This week's conversations reminded me why I love this community. HomeSteadHow's video on breaking a 500-day stall hit 37K views, and Jen's story is one I've heard dozens of times now. She cut dairy and the scale finally moved. The comments section turned into its own support group, with women sharing almost identical experiences about dairy being their hidden stall trigger. It lines up with what we know about casein sensitivity and its effects on insulin response in some people. Meanwhile, Dr. Ken Berry dropped a simple day-in-the-life video that honestly felt like a breath of fresh air. No complicated protocols, no optimization talk, just a doctor eating meat and living his life. It's a good reminder that this doesn't have to be perfect to work. And speaking of "just start where you are," our 90-day bridal carnivore post picked up real traction this week. If you're planning a wedding or know someone who is, that piece breaks down a practical timeline without the crash-diet nonsense.
looking_ahead: Summer's here and we're leaning into it. Next week you'll get carnivore grilling guides, tips for staying on track at cookouts, and fresh content built around warm-weather eating. We're also adding new features to the KetoDial calculator, so if you haven't tried it yet, now's a great time. Hit reply and tell us what topics you want to see. We actually read every one.
